name: @pipeworx/mcp-cbs-nl

tools.name: search_tables
tools.description: Find CBS StatLine datasets by keyword (matched against title). Returns table id, title, period and language. Table ids ending in "eng"/"ENG" have English labels; others are Dutch.

keyword.description: Search term matched in the table title, e.g. "population", "energy", "wages".

english_only.description: If true, only return English-language tables (id ends in "eng"). Default false.

tools.name: table_info
tools.description: Metadata for one table: title, summary, time period covered, frequency, update status and description. Pass a table id like "37296eng".

tools.name: table_dimensions
tools.description: Column/dimension definitions for a table (DataProperties): what each field means, its key, type, unit and decimals. Use this before get_data to learn which $select keys and $filter dimensions exist.

tools.name: dimension_values
tools.description: List the valid codes/labels for one dimension of a table (a sub-endpoint such as "Periods" or a region/category dimension key, as named in the table root or table_dimensions).

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Fetch observations from a table (TypedDataSet). Supports OData v3 query params. Use $select to pick columns (from table_dimensions keys) and $filter to subset, e.g. filter="Periods eq '2020JJ00'". Always set a $top to avoid huge responses.

skip.description: OData $skip, rows to skip for paging.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cbs-nl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cbs-nl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
